about.body: The AJ300P is Jaguar Land Rover's Ingenium-family turbocharged 3.0-litre inline-six petrol engine, introduced in 2019. In the Jaguar range, its primary application is the F-Pace P400, where it's paired with a 48V mild-hybrid system.

byModel.body: Across the F-Pace, the AJ300P is the top-spec petrol powertrain in the P400 variant (X761, 2019–present), producing 400 hp with mild-hybrid assistance.

compatibility.body: Because the AJ300P is paired with a 48V MHEV system, compatibility depends on matching the exact vehicle specification. The engine and its associated ancillaries — including the mild-hybrid components — are specific to the F-Pace P400 application.
